claims.statement: Florentine painters including Botticelli, Perugino, Ghirlandaio and Cosimo Rosselli are called to Rome by Sixtus IV. Leonardo is not among them.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Commission records; dates are approximate.
